# Security Policy

This is a personal dotfiles repository. There are no supported versions in
the usual sense — `main` is the only branch that matters, and it's kept
current.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you find a security issue (e.g. a credential-handling bug, an unpinned
supply-chain risk, or something that could execute unintended code during
bootstrap), please report it privately via [GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting](https://github.com/jeckhart/dotfiles/security/advisories/new)
rather than opening a public issue.
